metaTitle: VeroMenu – Multilingual QR menus for restaurants
metaDescription: A QR menu in minutes: reviewed AI translations in up to 16 languages, EU-compliant allergen labelling, table ordering and analytics without a cookie banner. Hosted in Germany.

footer.tagline: The multilingual QR menu for restaurants, cafés and takeaways – with reviewed translations and reliable allergen information.

hero.eyebrow: The QR menu built for restaurants in Germany
hero.subtitle: VeroMenu turns your menu into a QR menu in up to 16 languages. Every AI translation is double-checked and translated back into your language, allergens are labelled to EU standards – and nothing goes live until you approve it.
hero.point2: A photo of your menu is enough

features.title: Everything a great menu needs – and nothing that slows you down.
features.subtitle: Less typing, fewer questions at the table, more certainty on allergens. Built for the daily reality of kitchen and floor staff.

translate.title: AI translation with a second check
translate.body: A second model rates every translation, and a back-translation shows you whether the meaning holds. Protect terms like “Maultaschen” in your glossary.

allergens.title: Allergen assistant with a review step
allergens.body: AI suggests the 14 major allergens and additives from your ingredients. Guests only see what you have confirmed – compliant with EU food labelling law.

import.title: Import your menu from a photo or PDF
import.body: Snap, upload, done: categories, dishes, prices and sizes are recognised. You review a preview before anything is applied.

assistant.title: Voice-controlled AI assistant
assistant.body: “Set the lunch special to €9.90 and mark the pumpkin soup as vegan.” Every change is shown as a preview first – it is applied only once you say OK.

tables.title: QR per table & ordering
tables.body: Print-ready QR codes for every table. On the Pro plan guests order directly – the kitchen sees it instantly on the order board.

stats.title: Analytics without a cookie banner
stats.body: Views, popular dishes and your guests’ languages – counted without cookies and without any consent banner.

themes.title: Designs that match your style
themes.body: From country inn to cocktail bar: themes with your logo, colours and photos – without writing a single line of code.

team.title: Team & roles
team.body: Floor staff mark dishes as sold out, the kitchen sees orders, owners keep an eye on everything. Custom roles included.

gdpr.title: GDPR & hosting in Germany
gdpr.body: Servers in Germany, data processing agreement included, no tracking cookies and no guest data sent to AI providers.

quality.title: AI that shows its work.
quality.subtitle: No flying blind in languages you don’t speak: VeroMenu shows you what the AI did – and you decide what your guests see.
quality.translationBody: A second AI model checks every translation for meaning, culinary terms and tone. The back-translation makes mistakes visible – even in Arabic or Chinese.
quality.allergenTitle: Allergens: a suggestion is not an approval
quality.allergenBody: AI makes suggestions, the responsibility stays with you – and that is exactly how VeroMenu is built.
quality.step1Body: Allergens and additives from ingredients and descriptions; unclear cases go to the review list.
quality.step2Body: One click per dish – documented with name and timestamp.
quality.step3Body: If the recipe changes, the information is automatically sent back for review.

how.title: A multilingual menu in three steps
how.step1Body: Photo, PDF or by hand: AI creates categories, dishes and prices for you.
how.step2Body: Check translations via the back-translation, confirm allergens – you have the final say.
how.step3Body: Print, place them on the tables, done. Changes go live instantly – no reprinting.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Can’t find your question? Write to us – we usually reply on the same business day.
faq.q1: Do my guests need an app?
faq.a1: No. Guests scan the QR code with their camera and the menu opens in the browser – automatically in their phone’s language, as long as you have enabled it.
faq.q2: How reliable are the AI translations?
faq.a2: Every translation is checked and rated by a second AI model. You also get a back-translation into your language, so you can verify the meaning even in languages you don’t speak. Protect regional terms like “Currywurst” in the glossary – and you decide what goes live.
faq.q3: Who is responsible for allergen information?
faq.a3: Legally, your business is – no software changes that. VeroMenu supports you: AI suggests allergens, unclear cases go to the review list, and guests only ever see information you have confirmed. If a recipe changes, the information is automatically sent back for review.
faq.q4: Do I need a cookie banner?
faq.a4: Not for the guest menu. We set no cookies there and count views anonymously using a daily-rotating, irreversible hash – no profiles, no tracking.
faq.q5: Can I bring over my existing menu?
faq.a5: Yes. Upload a photo or PDF – AI recognises categories, dishes, prices and sizes. You see a preview and only apply what’s correct.
faq.a6: On servers in Germany. For AI features, only your menu content is transmitted – never your guests’ data. A data processing agreement (DPA) is included.
faq.q7: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a7: Yes, all paid plans can be cancelled monthly. The Free plan stays free forever.
faq.q8: Can guests order directly at the table?
faq.a8: Yes, on the Pro plan. Guests order via their table’s QR code and the order appears instantly on the order board – accept it manually or automatically.
